key_idea: Input-side defense for road-sign classifiers: add binary adaptive-threshold and edge maps to the image so natural-looking shadow perturbations lose effect, with little loss of benign accuracy.

data: GTSRB and LISA; four backbones; three physical attack types (shadow, natural light, printed patch).

relation_to_project: Slide 02: a training-time defense with no inference overhead, the comparator for any claim that a run-time module adds value; also covers natural-light attacks (slide 04).
